When They’re Happy, We’re Happy

Your little friends are in our care!

In 2016, we rolled up our sleeves with love to make sure our little friends happily enjoy every minute they spend away from home. In our charming villa in Koşuyolu, we created a second home for our closest friends. Drawing on the warm relationships we have built with our feline and canine friends and the experience we have gained over time, we have thought of everything your furry friend needs to have a wonderful time while you are away. We have created a happy place to stay and socialise so that the most precious members of our family feel at home.

WITH LOVE, SINCE 2016.

We have worked hard to be able to say, “The youngest member of your family is in safe hands!” during the happy holiday you give your little friends. Here, our feline and canine friends will enjoy plenty of food, care and play, and have their grooming done, but they will still be themselves when they reunite with you. We promise: we won’t take your place, but we’ll make sure they don’t feel your absence.

“We won’t take your place,
but we’ll make sure they don’t feel your absence.”

A holiday for your little friend.

We love our little friends. We can’t wait to meet them.
